Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the paternal grandfather as Louis Philippe I, Duke of Orléans (1725–1785), confusing the great-grandfather with the grandfather. This synthesis error stemmed from conflating similarly titled individuals in the Orléans line, failing to correctly trace that Louis Philippe I (king) was the son of Louis Philippe II (Philippe Égalité), who is the true paternal grandfather of Charles d’Orléans.
